wiki.title: Judy Amabile
wiki.extract: Judith "Judy" Amabile is an American politician and businesswoman who served as a member of the Colorado House of Representatives from the 49th district and, prior to 2023, the 13th district. Elected in November 2020, she assumed office on January 13, 2021. In 2025, she was sworn in as a Colorado State Senator for District 18.
